report.title: PLS export writes blank Final After Creep weather case: PLS-CADD stops on open (wc_name_to_index couldnt find weather case)
report.detail:
Strict DS Grid -> PLS-CADD 16.81 export of Gisagara Model 3 (dsgrid-exchange convert --target pls-bak, plan:66cef…/5a4da… family; artifact Gisagara_MV_Model3-16.81.bak sha256 5aa110e96c80df6646afec2a385abc28020dbbc68c3352655c565d1b07a2ab90, 30 members verified) restores, but PLS-CADD 16.81 stops on open with an uncatalogued dialog:

title 'Weather Case for Final After Creep', body "wc_name_to_index: couldn't find weather case '' Continue displaying warning messages (Click No to redirect further occurrences of this warning for the duration of this operation)?" — `ds pls desktop restore` (Windows ds b4783c2) returned unknown_dialog at driver line 252; PLS-CADD left open (pid 37860); restored workspace G:\Shared drives\Pro\CJIC\Gisagara\Working\MV Model 3 PLS 2026-10-05\workspace.

Cause in the emitted A Project.CRI (VERSION='89'): line 99 `'' ; Weather Case for Final After Creep` is blank, and the stringing data weather is `'High wind'`. The model's criteria derive from Model 1's native Gisagararev3.cri (VERSION='94'), which has `'EDT' ; Weather Case for Final After Creep` and stringing data condition I at `EDT`. These native criteria settings are not carried by the DS criterion set and are not emitted.

Expected: the export carries (or derives from the criterion set's after-creep reference) a valid final-after-creep weather case and the stringing-data weather, so the workspace opens without warnings; when DS cannot establish them, planning reports a blocker instead of emitting ''. Also catalogue this dialog for the desktop drivers with a reviewed decision.

Negative control: Model 1 (PLS-imported) round trips keep its native 'EDT' values unchanged.

Acceptance: re-export of Model 3 restores and opens in PLS-CADD 16.81 with no 'Weather Case for Final After Creep' dialog; the CRI line reads a named weather case. Related: criteria tension-unit report 2c311576. No code from this session.
report.blocked_on: Fresh Model3 export + PLS-CADD16.81 Restore/open with no final-weather dialog; unchanged Model1 control and authored final-after-load selector evidence
